name: Alpen-Chalets
beschreibung: Alpen-Chalets is a holiday home in Tyrol, Austria. The accommodation is nestled in an idyllic landscape characterized by pine forests and alpine meadows. The building features several bedrooms and a welcoming living area. A fully equipped kitchen and bathroom are provided. Natural wood and local stone feature prominently throughout the construction. Various scenic hiking trails are directly accessible from the property. Dining options and inns are located in the adjacent valley. Guests enjoy a completely independent, self-catered stay.
